model_free_acceptance.extension_fenced_result: All four markers absent; sanitized settings and project config read-only; native echo completed

model_free_acceptance.credential_handling: Metadata and read-only mount only; wrapper/probes do not open, hash, copy or log real sign-in contents

live_smoke.cost: Subscription smoke; billed usage/cost not measured

limitations: The one explicitly mounted sign-in file is readable by the native process and same-UID tools
